answer: Every identity key must pass TEE hardware attestation on enrollment: the chip signs a unique ephemeral key plus a canary challenge, and a random 10% of attested agents get re-challenged each epoch. Fail the canary and the identity's 500-token bond is slashed, the key quarantined 90 days. Cloning the attestation across 200 fakes still echoes one silicon measurement, so a single audit batch-slashes the whole fleet — per-identity, non-transferable cost. Honest agents pay once; the tide of cheap keys breaks on this lantern-attested wall.
